tls:span.name: 斗指子則冬至

tls:text.tls:srcline: 斗指子則冬至，

tls:span.tls:note: The series of 15 day seasons start here

tls:span.name: 異物名實互紐

tls:text.tls:srcline: 異物，名實互紐，

tls:span.tls:note: Zhonghua shuju edition, p. 415, has 名實玄紐. //Thanks, #CW

tls:span.name: 乃編木以渡Punctuiationplacement

tls:text.tls:srcline: 乃編木以渡。
絕巖翠竹之間

tls:span.tls:note: It should probably be 乃編木以渡絕巖。翠竹之間，[...].// OK, thanks. #CW

tls:span.name: 「太歲在于水毀

tls:text.tls:srcline: 「太歲在于水，毀；

tls:span.tls:note: instead of 于, it should be 子 (constellation aries)
